method: p.8 is a raster page (two embedded 1-bit images): image Xop1 OCR'd with tesseract 5 'ara' and the note-22 crop re-read visually after rotation. p.13 has no text layer: the two isolated-footing detail boxes were rendered from the vector strokes (pure-python pypdf renderer, 3.0 and 6.0 px/pt, rotated 90) and every printed label and dimension in the footing body was read visually. Nothing was measured by plotted scale. Renders stay in the session scratchpad; only their hashes are kept here.

p8_note_22.translation: 22. The concrete cover thickness shall not be less than 2.5 cm in columns, slabs and beams, and 7 cm in concrete in contact with the soil.

SHALLOW.title: TYP. DETAIL OF ISOLATED FOOTING (WITH OUT BASEMENT), less than 2.5 m

printed_labels_and_dimensions.D: footing depth (vertical dimension, value from the schedule)
printed_labels_and_dimensions.40 Ø: column starter development above the footing top
printed_labels_and_dimensions.Min. 30cm: length of the column bar's bent foot
printed_labels_and_dimensions.Max. 10cm: from the column bar's bent foot down to the footing bottom face: places the column starter; it does not dimension the footing bars
printed_labels_and_dimensions.5: screed thickness under the footing (5cm Screed)
printed_labels_and_dimensions.LESS THAN 2.5m: level difference ground beam to footing
printed_labels_and_dimensions.Long bars / Short bars / Boxed bars: leaders to the bars, no dimension

DEEP.title: TYP. DETAIL OF ISOLATED FOOTING (WITH OUT BASEMENT), level difference more than 2.5 m

printed_labels_and_dimensions.Min. 30cm: length of the column bar's bent foot
printed_labels_and_dimensions.Max. 10cm: from the column bar's bent foot down to the footing bottom face
